in_marathi.name: Istkhar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Istkhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Istkhar is a Hindi and Sanskrit name that means 'God's grace'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ist' which means 'he' or 'this' and 'khar' meaning 'grace' or 'blessing'. In Hindu mythology, this name can be associated with Lord Vishnu who is believed to bestow grace and blessings upon his devotees.
